finding.claim: _generate dereferences obj.toJSON without a null check, so compare/generate with a null new value throws TypeError instead of producing a replace patch.
finding.title: Null dereference on obj.toJSON in _generate

verifier.reason: At duplex.js:121 _generate accesses typeof obj.toJSON with only the identity guard at duplex.js:118, and compare at duplex.js:178 passes tree2 directly without validation, so a non-identical null new value throws TypeError before any replace patch is generated.

repro.reason: reproducer failed L0: controlCode assertion is not tied to a call of an imported symbol; testCode assertion is not tied to a call of an imported symbol; control and trigger must use a different input: no shared symbol is called in both codes
